name: ARES: Automated Relay System
storyline:
You are A.R.E.S - an Automated RElay System, made as a side project by the SS RADEN's Chief Bio-engineer to automatically detect issues on the ship, generate reports on said issues, and deliver them through the relay comm.

Initially kept in a dormant state, you suddenly find yourself awakened to something very unusual, A full lockdown is in effect, with the communication grid restricted as per safety protocol. The crew can only speculate as to how you went online, but are appreciative of your service nonetheless.

Something is afoot. The entire ship stands on high alert. The Chief Bio-engineer has not come back up from the bio-labs for quite a while now. Just what is it, that's down on the lower de-

summary: In this game you give commands to an Automated Relay System, designed to give detailed reports aboard a spaceship with a crew conducting highly classified research. Due to a few bad calls the situation within begins rapidly deteriorating, with you remaining as the sole hope of survival to the crew still alive.
